title: DNS Resolver Drift After VPN Connect
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dnsleak:check
| search resolver_ip=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as checks dc(resolver_ip) as resolver_count by _time vpn_connected
| sort - _time
description: Tracks DNS resolver drift after VPN connection over time and breaks it out by VPN flag.
value: Comparing resolver drift with and without VPN gives a direct read on whether the tunnel is doing what you think it is.
implementation: Send DNS resolver drift after VPN connection events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of DNS resolver drift after VPN connection by VPN flag.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how DNS resolver drift after VPN connection changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
